시편-99-1.title: 시편 99장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-99-1.exegesis: 4-6. make a loud noise-- or, "burst forth" ( Is 14:7 ; 44:23 ). before ... King-- hail Him as your sovereign; and while, with every aid to demonstrate zeal and joy, intelligent creatures are invited to praise, as in Psa 96:11-13 , inanimate nature is also summoned to honor Him who triumphs and rules in righteousness and equity.
시편-99-1.theologicalNote: 4-6. make a loud noise-- or, "burst forth" ( Is 14:7 ; 44:23 ). before ... 시편-99-2.title: 시편 99장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-99-2.exegesis: PSALM 99 Psa 99:1-9 . God's government is especially exercised in and for His Church, which should praise Him for His gracious dealings. 1. sitteth ... cherubim-- (compare 1Sa 4:4 ; Psa 80:1 ). tremble ... be moved-- inspired with fear by His judgments on the wicked.
시편-99-2.theologicalNote: PSALM 99 Psa 99:1-9 . God's government is especially exercised in and for His Church, which should praise Him for His gracious dealings. 1. sitteth ... cherubim-- (compare 1Sa 4:4 ; Psa 80:1 ). tremble ... be moved-- inspired with fear by His judgments on the wicked.

시편-99-3.title: 시편 99장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-99-3.exegesis: 2. great in Zion-- where He dwells ( Psa 9:11 ).
시편-99-3.theologicalNote: 2. great in Zion-- where He dwells ( Psa 9:11 ).

시편-99-4.title: 시편 99장 4절 역사문법적 주해
시편-99-4.exegesis: 3. thy ... name-- perfections of justice, power, &c. great and terrible name-- producing dread ( De 10:17 ), and to be praised by those over whom He is exalted ( Psa 97:9 ). it is holy-- or, "He is holy" ( Psa 99:5 , 9 ; Is 6:3 ).
시편-99-4.theologicalNote: 3. thy ... name-- perfections of justice, power, &c. great and terrible name-- producing dread ( De 10:17 ), and to be praised by those over whom He is exalted ( Psa 97:9 ). it is holy-- or, "He is holy" ( Psa 99:5 , 9 ; Is 6:3 ).

시편-99-5.title: 시편 99장 5절 역사문법적 주해
시편-99-5.exegesis: 4-5. To His wise and righteous government all nations should render honor. king's ... judgment-- His power is combined with justice. he is holy-- (compare Psa 22:3 ).
시편-99-5.theologicalNote: 4-5. To His wise and righteous government all nations should render honor. king's ... judgment-- His power is combined with justice. he is holy-- (compare Psa 22:3 ).
